faq.q: Is Tsawwassen East an official City of Delta neighbourhood?
faq.a: No. It is a Paragon sub-area name for the Boundary Bay side of Tsawwassen, planned under the Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 8400 (2024) — a single consolidated plan with no area-plan schedules — and no official boundary exists for the name (adaptation source: batch-1/tsawwassen-east-guide.md, read 2026-11-01).

faq.q: What beach and trails are on the east side?
faq.a: Boundary Bay Regional Park and Centennial Beach (Metro Vancouver) are on Boundary Bay Road, with the Dyke Trail and the Savannah and Raptor trails, and Cammidge House in the park (adaptation source: batch-1/tsawwassen-east-guide.md, read 2026-11-01).

faq.q: Which schools serve the east side?
faq.a: Catchments are address-based in SD37. The adaptation source's locator result for the sample address 570 Boundary Bay Rd is South Park Elementary (K–7) and South Delta Secondary (8–12), with no middle-school category; SD37 also publishes Tsawwassen Area catchment maps (updated October 2017) and directs families to the Baragar locator or their local school.
TransLink route 601 runs Boundary Bay trips via 12 Avenue, Boundary Bay Road, 3 Avenue and 67 Street to 1A Avenue, continuing through South Delta Exchange and Ladner Exchange to Bridgeport Station.
